name: What should I do if I smell gas after a new installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I smell gas after a new installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you smell gas after a new installation or at any time, prioritize safety immediately. Evacuate everyone from the building, and do not use any electrical devices, light switches, or phones inside, as these can create a spark. Once safely outside, call your gas utility company's emergency line and then call Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC. We will dispatch a technician to assess the situation. Your gas utility can shut off the main gas supply if necessary, and we can then identify and resolve the issue safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you smell gas, evacuate immediately, do not use electrical devices, and call your gas utility and Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC from outside.
